title: Knight Dialer
description:
A knight starts on any digit of a standard phone keypad and makes valid chess-knight moves between digit keys. Return the number of distinct digit sequences of length `n`, modulo `10^9 + 7`.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 1
Output: 10
```

```text
Input: n = 2
Output: 20
```

```text
Input: n = 3131
Output: 136006598
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 5000`
